description: Deterministic Pakistan tax engine: 14-step analysis chain (profile -> transaction -> legislation -> applicability -> treatment -> error -> risk -> evidence -> verification -> calculation -> exceptions -> adjustment -> return impact -> follow-up). Tri-state condition evaluation (missing facts -> needs_info, never guessed), date-scoped rule/calc version selection, verified-preferred calculations. Migrated from the standalone tax engine (Phase 0). Knowledge tables and working-data tables are namespaced apart inside the one hub database (the source's two-DB discipline, preserved as a documented split).
name: tax
title: Pakistan Tax Rules and Evidence Engine
